messages:
emily: Heads up — a new hire hit a blocker in the python SDK quickstart. `pip install -e .` fails on macOS arm64 during onboarding. Error references `TypeAlias` coming from async client.

emily: Error snippet:
```
$ pip install -e .
Obtaining file:///workspace/redwood-python-sdk
Installing collected packages: typing-extensions, ...
ERROR: Cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions' (/opt/homebrew/.../typing_extensions/__init__.py)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"redwood/client/async_client.py\", line 13, in <module>
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
ImportError: cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions'
```

noah: Thanks for the report. Which python/pip/typing-extensions versions on the failing runner?

emily: macos-13 GH Actions, Python 3.10.6, pip 23.1, `typing-extensions==4.0.1` per `pip freeze`. Interesting that x86 CI is green.

sophia: Likely a transitive dep resolves to an older `typing-extensions` on arm. `TypeAlias` only available in newer backports. Two practical fixes: 1) pin `typing-extensions` in `pyproject.toml` to a minimum `>=4.6.0` so editable installs get a compatible wheel; 2) add a tiny runtime fallback in `async_client.py` while we roll the dep change.

sophia: Fallback pattern suggestion (temporary):
```py
try:
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
except Exception:
    from typing import Any as TypeAlias  # runtime fallback for old typing-extensions
```
Add a TODO comment referencing the dependency PR.

noah: Prefer the dependency pin + CI test. Fallback feels hacky and could mask other incompatibilities. Also add a short GH Actions job that does a fresh `pip install -e .` on `macos-13` and runs `python -c \"import importlib; importlib.import_module('redwood.client.async_client')\"` to catch this early.

emily: I'll open a PR with: (A) `pyproject.toml` pin `typing-extensions = \">=4.6.0,<5\"`; (B) new `editable-install-macos` job; (C) a minimal smoke test that imports `redwood.client.async_client` after install. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/1402 (WIP).

sophia: Nice. Also add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about editable installs and PEP 660 pitfalls so new hires know why `pip install -e .` can differ from `pip install .`.

build-bot: CI: macos-editable-job failed earlier today for PR #1399 — logs show `typing-extensions==4.0.1` present. See https://ci.redwood.example/4567 for details.

noah: For release notes, include an advisory: "If you pin lockfiles, ensure `typing-extensions >= 4.6.0` when using the python SDK to avoid import errors on macOS arm."

emily: Will push the PR changes today and add the changelog blurb. If needed we can land the fallback as a hotfix and revert once the dependency is pinned.

sophia: Sounds good. Ping me once CI passes and I'll merge. :+1:
